Reference role: only Guan Yu's recognizable phoenix eyes, red face, long beard, green-black visual identity, dragon and refined illustrative style; do NOT copy heroic rider composition. New original dark myth: defeat at Maicheng transforms mortal sorrow into colossal Asura vengeance.
COMPOSITION: very strong two-scale vertical narrative. The upper central 65% is a COLOSSAL wrathful ASURA manifestation of GUAN YU, massive shoulders and torso rising through stormclouds, open mouth roaring grief and rage, unmistakable red face and Guan Yu eyebrows/long beard, flowing disheveled white hair and white beard, jade-black demonic armor with broad sweeping shapes, spectacular yet anatomically readable muscular arms. He is visibly supernatural and gigantic, not merely an ordinary man in different armor. Behind his head/shoulders a huge emerald GREEN CHINESE DRAGON apparition also roars in vengeance, powerful broad dragon head, majestic antlers, substantial neck vanishing into clouds; no thin snake coils. Main god face at center x50% y26%, dragon head near x76% y20%; sharp and readable. Coherent emerald and crimson energy ribbons only, no glitter particles.
LOWER THIRD: small mortal elderly Guan Yu on the actual muddy battlefield, ragged green-black robe, long WHITE beard, disheveled hair, weathered proud face raised to the giant sky figure with grief and defiance. He remains intact and alive-looking as a symbolic mortal remnant, no severed head or gore. Beside his boots lies his fallen red horse Red Hare, clearly a horse with natural anatomy, still body, no exposed wounds or blood. He holds a LONG Green Dragon Crescent Glaive with broad recognizable crescent blade bearing specific battle nicks and a visible crack; shaft is solid straight coaxial rigid steel, continuous across the hand and long enough, not twisted or broken into disconnected pieces. Weapon size appropriate to him. Deliberate battle damage on blade ONLY, not noise texture scattered over objects.
At lower-left/middle background a Chinese fortified stone CITY GATE, grounded fortress architecture. On its actual gate lintel must read EXACT TWO CHARACTERS '麦城', large enough legible, painted/carved on stone following perspective and light, no floating subtitle/no black sticker panel. City and background subdued, NOT heavenly palace. Mortal figure positioned x45% y75% and horse across bottom center, gate x23% y67%, clear of rightmost lower 25% reserved for eventual UI. Both faces and essential hand/grip centered safe from frame.
Lighting: mournful cool dim earth contrasted with emerald-red supernatural wrath above, controlled clean rim lights, strong visual hierarchy. Sharp principal faces, clean intentional linework and broad detailed armor planes, naturally softened distant city/sky only. No photographic realism, no oil painting, no muddy faces, no bruised swollen features, no gold dust, no spark confetti, no tiny random bright specks, no metallic noise, no granular scattered highlights, no fog over faces. This is original mythology based on Maicheng tragedy, NOT Baidicheng. No card border, no stars, no text except the diegetic '麦城'.
